en.Fris kruid uit de plasranden van het Kru: Fresh herb from the pool edges of the Creeping Swamp. Lovely kick in tea and brews.
en.GOUD! Het dak ging bijna van de arena af: GOLD! The crowd nearly blew the roof off the arena!
en.Ga naar het fornuis rechts in de herberg: Go to the stove on the right inside the inn. Choose a dish and prepare Joris’ catch with Mila.
en.Ga op de planken van de schietlijn staan: Stand on the planks at the shooting line. From there you can see all three targets.
en.Gebruik de hark bij het rooster, blijf e: Use the rake at the grate, stand still for a moment, then open the sluice wheel. That will bring water back to the square and my flowers.
Use the winch; drive off its guardians.
en.Gebruik dit vaandel opnieuw: eerst de ke: Use this banner again: first the cairn ram, then the thorn slinger, then both with a shield warden. Attacks deal real damage. Use the banner to stop. No loot or XP; the exit stays clear.
en.Gebruik het altaar vóór je de arena inlo: Use the altar before entering the arena. It restores hearts and stamina. Beyond the combat door, you can return only after the boss.
en.Gedragen pantser: %.0f. Bonussen komen a: Worn armour: %.0f. Bonuses come only from your worn set.
en.Geef compost een bereikbare plek op je e: Give your compost an accessible place in the yard. Active batches move with it.
en.Geef de poel rust · vreedzame afloop: Leave the pool in peace · peaceful outcome
Give the Slime Gel to Mila at the inn.
en.Geef maar hier. Ik leg ze terug in de Bl: Hand them over. I'll put them back in the Blue Map.
en.Geen blokkade. De oefenpop doet geen sch: No block. The practice dummy does no damage; try the brief frontal guard again.
en.Geen nieuwe invoer ontvangen; je koppeli: No new input received; your binding has been kept.
en.Geen niveau of materialen vereist. Koop: No level or materials required. Talk to Tobias to buy them.
en.Geen probleem. Hier zijn je munten. Kom: No problem. Here are your coins. Come back when you're ready!
No change to your worn set.
en.Gehaald in %s seconden! Ga naar Tessa vo: Done in %s seconds! Go see Tessa for your reward.
You did it! Go see Tessa for your reward.
en.Geleend van Nelle. Gebruik bij het verst: Borrowed from Nelle. Use it at the blocked grate beside the village fountain, then return it to her.
en.Geneest 3 hartjes. Druk op H om te drink: Heals 3 hearts. Press H to drink.
en.Gereedschap wordt automatisch gebruikt e: Tools are used automatically and never wear out.
en.Gesmede bescherming. Vermindert schade m: Forged protection. Reduces damage by 2, to a minimum of 1 damage per hit.
en.Gesmolten ijzer voor een efficiëntere bi: Smelted iron for a more efficient axe.
en.Gesmolten koper voor een beter pikhouwee: Smelted copper for a better pickaxe.
en.Getijdenbaai: zandbank bij laagwater, ho: Tidal Cove: sandbank at low tide, high boardwalk always open. Free loan line and ferry by the western jetty.
en.Geurig kruid voor alchemie en stevige so: A fragrant herb for alchemy and hearty soup.
en.Gloeit zachtblauw. Het sterkste zwaard v: Glows a soft blue. The strongest sword in Azura.
en.Goed geoefend. Bij het vaandel kun je de: Good practice. Start the next exercise at the banner.
en.Goed. Ze zitten bij de mijnhoek en het w: Good. They lurk by the mine corner and the western copse. Watch out for the slippery ice.
en.Golembewakers in de Ruïne en de Echo-gro: Golem guardians in the Ruins and Echo Cave.
en.Gooi uit bij een visplek. Wacht tot de d: Cast your line at a fishing spot. Wait until the bobber sinks and an exclamation mark appears. Then press E, quick!
en.Goud: wandelpad · blauw: gekozen veerrou: Gold: footpath · blue: selected ferry route · white ring: here
en.Goud: zeven rondes, en in de laatste ron: Gold: seven rounds, and in the last round a Crystal Golem comes out of the gate. The entry fee is 50 coins.
en.Gouden ring: volgende doorgang voor je g: Gold ring: next passage for your tracked quest.
en.Grasrug, strand en uitzichtpunt. De oost: A grassy ridge, beach and viewpoint. The eastern boardwalk leads to Tidal Cove; the ferry takes you back.
en.Gratis geleend bij de kist in de Getijde: Borrowed free from the chest in Tidal Cove. Reusable at either line post; never consumed.
en.Gratis materiaalkist en vaste meubelplek: Free material storage and fixed furniture spots. Raf shares his line pattern; Greta and Lena help at their existing workplaces. No rent or upkeep.
en.Greta de smid gaat hier zeker van opkijk: Greta the Smith is going to be amazed! Go show it to her at the Smithy.
en.Greta gebruikt onze rustige lichtkern in: Greta uses our calm light core in her workshop. That's restoration reaching beyond this cave.
en.Greta kan iets met de herstelde kern. Zo: Greta could use the restored core. Find her workbench in the smithy when you're back in the village.
en.Greta leent haar tang en sleutel. Geen m: Greta lends you her tongs and wrench. No materials used. The first repair gives 6 Smithing XP and the strike-wrap pattern; later practice gives no extra XP.
en.Greta smeedt ijzer voor 5 slijmgel en 40: Greta forges iron for 5 slime gel and 40 coins. A shorter fight leaves more room to dodge.
en.Greta zoekt deze kern voor haar oude wer: Greta needs this core for her old workshop. Grounding powder from the library offers a peaceful solution; defeating the guardians also works.
en.Greta · smederij in het noordwesten van: Greta · smithy in the northwest of the village
en.Greta: de naden sluiten nog niet aan. Sc: Greta: the edges do not line up yet. Slide the loose jaw to the white line.
en.Greta: los houdt niet; te strak klemt he: Greta: loose will not hold; too tight crushes the sample. Choose firm pressure.
en.Grip en een lichte tred: 4% sneller lope: Grip and a light step: 4% faster movement and 15 extra stamina. Uses the same hand slot as attack gloves.
en.Groei op actieve speeltijd · droogte pau: Active play time growth · dry crops safely pause
en.Groeit · nog %.0f s actieve speeltijd: Growing · %.0f s of active play remaining
en.Grond voor druiven en bloemen; paden en: Soil for grapes and flowers; paths and clear passages stay protected.
en.Grote gele bloemen boven zwaardvormig bl: Large yellow flowers above sword-shaped leaves on the damp lakeshore.
en.HA! Een nieuwe vechter! Welkom in de are: HA! A new fighter! Welcome to the arena of Daybreak Village. I'm Bruno, the Arena Master.
en.Ha, een reiziger! Ik ben Kasper. Ik verh: Ha, a traveller! I'm Kasper. I trade everything the slimes won't eat.
en.Haal Joris' vismand met je hengel uit he: Use your fishing rod to retrieve Joris’ basket, just left of the start of the middle pier at Silverlake.
en.Haal Tessa's schietbaan: drie doelwitten: Beat Tessa's shooting range: three targets before time runs out.
en.Haal de verloren weerkaart op bij de sch: Collect the lost weather chart at the shelter in the southeast of the Mountain Pass.
en.Haal eerst Joris' maaltijdmand bij de mi: First retrieve Joris’ meal hamper by the middle pier.
en.Haal eerst het klimtouw bij het kamp naa: First get the climbing rope at the camp beside the entrance.
en.Haal eerst je gratis tuinhak bij het tui: Collect your free hoe at the garden sign first.
en.Haal je hengel bij Joris aan het Zilverm: Collect your fishing rod from Joris at Silver Lake.
en.Haal zaden en stekken bij je tuingids of: Get seeds and cuttings from your garden guide or the supplies inside your house.
en.Hak oogstbare stronken. Wordt automatisc: Chop harvestable stumps. Used automatically; never wears out.
en.Halt! Oh, jij bent het. Het Fluisterbos: Halt! Oh, it's you. The Whispering Woods are dangerous. Slimes and bats everywhere.
en.Handig, als je ten zuiden weer groen gra: Handy, when you want to see green grass in the south again.
en.Handige tips: lach nooit om een slijm. Z: Handy tips: never laugh at a slime. They understand more than you think. And don't give them apples, because they'll eat them. (Source: a farmer from Daybreak Village who tried it himself.)
en.Handschoenen en banden helpen met aanval: Gloves and bands help with attack speed, tools or a distinct coastal technique.
en.Harnassen verminderen zware treffers. Ee: Armor reduces heavy hits. A hit always deals at least 1 damage.
en.Harsachtig hout uit het IJsdal. Brandt l: Resinous wood from IJsdal. Burns long and warm.
Have 150 coins in your pocket at once.
Reach the max of eight hearts.
en.Heb je Muis al gezien? Zoek de pootafdru: Have you seen Muis? Look for pawprints by the southern forest path. Give her time to settle if she gets scared.
en.Heb je al genoeg slijmgel? Je hebt er {g: Got enough Slime Gel yet? You have {gel} of 5.
en.Heb je de dauwklauwen al?: Do you have the dewclaws yet?
en.Heb je de kruiden al?: Do you have the herbs yet?
en.Heb je de nachtlantaarn al gevonden?: Have you found the night lantern yet?
en.Heb je de steen al?: Do you have the stone yet?
en.Heb je de veenbessen al? Mijn maag knort: Got the cranberries yet? My stomach growls louder than the toads.
en.Heb je de vellen en het vlees al?: Do you have the hides and the meat yet?
en.Heb je het gehoord? De Blauwe Kaart stra: Did you hear? The Blue Map is glowing bright blue again! All thanks to you.
en.Heb je iets moois gevonden in het bos?: Have you found anything beautiful in the forest?
Hero! Hold on, before you go and rest.
en.Heldenlevel %d! +%d munten voor je uitru: Hero level %d! +%d coins for your equipment.
en.Help Nelle bij het rooster ten westen va: Help Nelle at the grate west of the fountain. Use her rake to clear the reeds.
en.Help je de oversteek herstellen?: Will you help restore the crossing?
en.Help je de warmte terugbrengen?: Will you help bring back the warmth?
en.Helpt gewonde vijanden met een zichtbaar: Helps wounded enemies with a visible song. A sword hit interrupts its healing.
en.Hengel van Joris; visplekken bij het Zil: Fishing rod from Joris; fishing spots at Silver Lake.
en.Hengel: gratis van Visser Joris aan het: Fishing rod: free from Joris the Fisher at Silver Lake.
Repair the bridge by the Reed Archive.
en.Herstel de twee vuurkorven voor de noord: Restore the two braziers outside the northern houses. Fuel them with wood, winter glow or prism technology; keep cold enemies away while they warm up.
en.Herstel eerst de Blauwe Kaart. Daal daar: First restore the Blue Map. Then descend beneath the Crystal Temple and defeat the Forgotten Guardian. No coins required.
en.Herstel eerst de bron in de Zonnekloof b: Restore the Sunwell Gorge spring on Sana’s expedition first.
en.Herstel eerst het tijrad in de veilige z: First repair the tide wheel in the safe southern passage. The keeper will wait; the way back stays open.
Restore the balance in the Dew Woods.
en.Herstel één tegel per druk; je krijgt he: Restore one tile per press; its seed is returned, but the plant is removed.
en.Herstelt 2 hartjes. Gebruik via Beroepen: Restores 2 hearts. Use through Professions → Food & drink.
en.Herstelt 3 hartjes. Gemaakt in de herber: Restores 3 hearts. Cooked at the inn. Use through Professions → Food & drink.
en.Herstelt 40 uithoudingsvermogen. Gebruik: Restores 40 stamina. Use through Professions → Food & drink.
en.Herstelt 60 uithoudingsvermogen. Gebruik: Restores 60 stamina. Use through Professions → Food & drink.
en.Het Fluisterbos, de Vergeten Ruïne en de: The Whispering Woods, the Forgotten Ruins, and the Echo Cave. Take good care of yourself!
en.Het Sterrenzwaard gloeit in je hand. Het: The Starsword glows in your hand. It's as light as a feather and as sharp as a beam of starlight.
en.Het Sterrenzwaard is nu van jou. Het is: The Starsword is yours now. It is made from the light of the Star Map. Use it well, hero of Azura.
en.Het amulet ligt op het eilandje, midden: The amulet lies on the islet, in the middle of the quickmire pool. The footbridges get you there.
en.Het bergkamp heeft klimtouw. Steek de pa: The mountain camp has climbing rope. Cross the upper pass while the pennants hang loose. Secure the eastern rope post and collect the weather chart at the southeastern shelter.
en.Het blauwe altaar hier is ouder dan het: The blue altar here is older than the village. Touch it and you can travel to any altar you know.
en.Het bos is veel rustiger sinds je de Sli: The woods are much calmer since you beat the Slime King. Thanks, hero!
en.Het brede hoge pad brengt je terug naar: The broad high path leads back to the ferry. The southern viewpoint is a quiet side route.
en.Het dorp viert feest. Rust maar uit, hel: The village is celebrating. Get some rest, hero. You've earned it.
en.Het groene gel trekt weg uit de tempel,: The green goo drains out of the temple, trickles across the land like a river... and disappears.
en.Het havenboek kan een waarschuwing bij d: The harbor ledger can place a warning on the correct sailing route. Compare both observations before drawing a conclusion. A mistake costs nothing.
en.Het havenrad draait. De Schelpenhoeder h: The harbor wheel turns. The Shellkeeper has accepted your trial of strength; the passage stays clear.
en.Het herstelde rad kan het water verdelen: The repaired wheel can divide the flow. Leave the keeper its quiet pool, or feed the harbor wheel and voluntarily take its trial of strength. Your choice stays visible. The story reward is equal; you can still retreat from the trial.
en.Het hoge pad langs de noordkant blijft b: The high path along the north side stays open at every tide.
en.Het hout brak op de modderige rivieroeve: The timber broke on the muddy riverbank
en.Het huis is warm. De bewoners keren teru: The house is warm. Its residents are returning.
en.Het is goud dat nooit roestte, omdat het: It is gold that never rusted, because it kept the sun itself. That is what they say, anyway.
en.Het is hier pikkedonker. Volg het licht: It's pitch-dark in here. Follow the light of the torches.
en.Het is je nog niet gelukt, hè? Geen zorg: Haven't done it yet, huh? Don't worry. Everybody misses sometimes.
It's perfect. I'll put them back right away. Here's your reward: thirty coins.
en.Het kamp geeft klimtouw. Wacht op slappe: The camp provides climbing rope. Wait for slack pennants before crossing; the secured line makes later visits safe.
en.Het lage windscherm staat weer. Neem ger: The low windbreak stands again. Take your time; the high route back to the harbor stays clear.
en.Het land kwakt en borrelt. Blijf op de m: The land croaks and bubbles. Stay on the mud paths.
en.Het legendarische zwaard van de Sterrenk: The legendary sword of the Star Map. It shines like a star and hits harder than any other sword.
en.Het licht heeft de tuin gewekt. Dauwklau: The light has awakened the garden. Dewclaws grow along the stream; honey mushrooms beneath the old trees.
Light flows through the roots again.
en.Het meer is dichtgevroren. De vissen sla: The lake has frozen over. The fish sleep beneath it until spring, they say.
en.Het moeras ademt, hoor je dat? Vraag maa: The swamp breathes, do you hear it? Ask whatever you want to know.
en.Het net is weer heel. Joris kan zijn van: The net is repaired. Joris can keep his catch safe now.
This gate has been locked for ages.
en.Het poortje is dicht. Schiet met je boog: The gate is shut. Use your bow to shoot the two targets across the river!
The gate is shut. Use your bow to shoot the two old targets in the walls!
en.Het poortje zit op slot. Je hebt een sle: The gate is locked. You need a key.
en.Het proefstuk is klaar. Je kunt de hande: The sample is ready. You can practise these steps again later.
en.Het publiek gooit een hartje!: The crowd throws you a heart!
en.Het rad draait. De korte brug over de mi: The wheel turns. The short bridge over the central channel is dry; the broad southern route stays open too.
en.Het riet groeit rond de rustige poel. De: Reeds grow around the quiet pool. The keeper has withdrawn.
en.Het riet zit vast. Nelle, de hovenier me: The reeds are stuck. Nelle, the gardener in a straw hat, is standing beside the fountain. She has a rake.
en.Het rommelt onder de Kristaltempel. Zoek: Something is rumbling under the Crystal Temple. Search the back of the temple for a way down.
en.Het rooster is vrij. Draai het sluisrad: The grate is clear. Open the sluice wheel a little to the south and follow the water to the fountain.
en.Het rooster is vrij. Draai nu het sluisr: The grate is clear. Now open the sluice wheel to the south.
en.Het slib verklaart de breuk niet. Schelp: The silt does not explain the break. Shell grit in cleanly fractured timber points to the hard outer shoal. Compare your notes and try again.
en.Het tijrad draait en de korte brug is dr: The tide wheel turns and the short bridge is dry. The long southern route always stays open.
en.Het verhaal klopt. De steen werkt. De da: The story is true. The stone works. The dew stays, but the mist softens.
en.Het verlichte pad naast dit vaandel leid: The lit path beside this banner leads to the practice yard. Try techniques and learn to read attack signals. The exit stays open.
en.Het wachtersboek en het reliëf vertellen: The guardbook and relief tell the same story: Wilfred stayed at the gate so others could reach the cave. What will you inscribe?
en.Het wandrek en de lamp hebben ieder een: The wall rack and lamp each have a fixed plinth away from the walking route. Placing, removing and changing the light cost nothing and do not consume furniture. Your material chest always works, even without furniture.
en.Het water is hier diep. Grote vissen zwe: The water is deep here. Big fish love deep water.
en.Het water komt op. Neem de hoge loopbrug: The tide is rising. Take the high boardwalk or the line posts; you can always return.
en.Het water staat boven dezelfde aanlegpal: Water rises above those same mooring posts. Residents leave their homes and move to the high island.
en.Het water staat lager en de brug is brui: The water is lower and the bridge is usable. Give Mees the good news.
en.Het water stroomt naar de fontein en de: Water flows to the fountain and the flower beds.
en.Het water stroomt! Nelle heeft haar hark: The water is flowing! Nelle has her rake back. The prism symbol resembles the one on Greta’s workbench.
en.Het water verbergt geen geschiedenis mee: Water no longer hides this history. The shield wardens protect their singer; break the formation or use the pillars as cover.
en.Het water zakt. De oostelijke oever en h: The water is falling. The eastern bank and Reed Archive are emerging.
The Crystal Temple goes very quiet.
en.Het zegel is gebroken! Er is een trap na: The seal is broken! There's a staircase going down.
en.Het zegel is gebroken! Zoek in de Krista: The seal is broken! Search the Crystal Halls for a key to the crystal gate.
en.Hier fluisteren de bomen. En de slijmen: Here the trees whisper. And the slimes can't be trusted.
en.Hier hangt de dauw zwaar. De bomen fluis: The dew hangs heavy here. The trees whisper more softly.
en.Hier is je beloning: 25 munten en 10 pij: Here's your reward: 25 coins and 10 arrows. Nice shooting!
en.Hier is mijn schat. Hij zat in mijn tas,: Here's my treasure. It was in my bag, but nothing else fits in there. Have fun with it.
en.Hier is ruimte voor een rustiger bezoek:: There's room for a calmer visit here: fishing, cooking, reading or finding herbs. This route will wait if you want to go elsewhere first.
en.Hier komt iedereen samen zodra het eten: Everyone will gather here when the food is ready. Prepare a portion at the stove to the left of the dining room. The meal can begin at any time.
en.Hier ligt je erfinrichting; berg die eer: Your yard layout occupies this spot. Pack it away in Arrange yard first.
en.Hier ligt landbouwgrond of een kanaal; j: Farmland or a channel already occupies this spot. Your garden is protected.
Here rests the keeper of the ruins.
en.Hier staat al iets; laat meubels naast e: Something is already here; leave room beside it.
en.Hier vecht je tegen golven vijanden, en: Here you fight wave after wave of enemies, and the whole village watches. Just listen to them cheer!
en.Hier wordt Wilfred herinnerd: de bewaker: Here we remember Wilfred: the guard who stayed.
en.Hier wordt Wilfred herinnerd: de gids di: Here we remember Wilfred: the guide who helped others escape.
en.Hier, drie helddrankjes en 25 munten. Da: Here, three Hero Potions and 25 coins. Thank you!
Here, a reward for your help.
Here, a lump of bog iron from my field. And some coins; a deal is a deal.
en.Hier, een warme wintergloed en wat munte: Here, a warm winter glow and some coins. The ice watch will not forget this.
en.Hier, je deel van de opbrengst. En een b: Here, your share of the proceeds. And a roast from my own stock, you've earned it.
en.Hier, neem mijn reservehengel. Gratis. M: Here, take my spare fishing rod. Free. But be nice to it.
en.Hierachter slaapt De Vergeten Wachter. W: The Forgotten Guardian sleeps behind here. Wake him, and there's no way out until the fight is over.
en.Hij bewaakt de Sterrenkaart. Dat is de a: He guards the Star Map. That's the very first map. Our Blue Map is just a copy of it.
en.Hij kreeg één opdracht: de Sterrenkaart: He got one job: guard the Star Map, forever. That's a really long time. At some point he got tired and went to sleep.
en.Hij zit muurvast. Misschien gaat hij pas: It's stuck tight. Maybe it will only open once the Blue Map is whole again.
en.Hmm, je hebt niet genoeg munten voor de: Hmm, you don't have enough coins for the entry fee.
en.Hmpf. Een bezoeker. Ik dacht dat de viss: Hmph. A visitor. I thought fish were the worst, but no: people.
en.Hmpf. Het dorp zit nog steeds vol met vi: Hmph. The village is still full of fish. I pay half, remember?
en.Hoe gaat het met de zoektocht? Je hebt {: How's the quest going? You have {crystals} of the 3 crystals.
en.Hoe gaat het met mijn boeken? Eén ligt o: How's the book hunt going? One is on the island, one is in Joris' Cabin and one is with Sanne.
en.Hoe gaat het nu de Slijmkoning weg is?: How are things now that the Slime King is gone?
en.Hoe is het met de Gouden Karper?: Any news on the Golden Carp?
en.Hoe vaker je het probeert, hoe nieuwsgie: The more you try, the more curious he gets. At least, that's what I tell myself.
en.Hoe vang ik een vis?: How do I catch a fish?
Hats and beanies above your hair.
en.Hoge graslanden, een vuurtoren en een ru: High grasslands, a lighthouse and a peaceful sea view. The broad western path takes you back to the harbour.
en.Hoge laarzen die modder en sneeuw trotse: Tall boots that defy mud and snow. Purely for looks; wear them over your equipment.
en.Hoge loopbrug: altijd open · veer: altij: High boardwalk: always open · ferry: always available
en.Hoge toppen, diepe sneeuw. Warm aan de l: High peaks, deep snow. Stay warm near the lanterns.
en.Hoi! Ik ben Tessa. Dit is mijn schietbaa: Hi! I'm Tessa. This is my shooting range.
en.Hoogwater · neem het hoge pad: High tide · take the high path
en.Hoor je dat gesputter? Er zit riet in he: Hear that spluttering? The grate is full of reeds. Here, borrow my rake. The grate is just south of me.
en.Houd %s vast en druk op %s voor je zwaar: Hold %s and press %s for your sword technique, or %s for a precise shot. Ordinary attacks cost no stamina.
en.Houd daarna E ingedrukt: dan stijgt de g: Then hold E: the green zone goes up. Let go, and it goes down. Keep the fish in the green until the bar is full.
en.Houd de deur en de gemarkeerde looproute: Keep the door and the marked walkway clear.
en.Houd de kroonruimte vrij van gewassen en: Keep canopy space clear of crops and channels. Place water two tiles from the trunk.
Keep the fish in the green zone.
en.Houd de vis in het groen!: Keep the fish in the green!
en.Houd deze plek vrij voor water, paden en: Keep this spot clear for water, paths and objects.
en.Houd paden en erfwerk vrij van de boomkr: Keep paths and yard furnishings clear of the canopy.
Hold and walk along a row.
Hold and walk along ripe crops. Perennials stay planted; vegetables return seeds.
en.Houd water, gebouwen, bruggen en bestaan: Keep water, buildings, bridges and existing passages clear.
en.Houdt afstand en richt langs een oranje: Keeps its distance and aims along an orange lane. Cover stops its thorn; your sword can shatter it too. A hit interrupts its preparation.
en.Hout van een oogstbare stronk. Voor smel: Wood from a harvestable stump. For smelting, tools and arrows.
en.Hout: snelle steek, 16 stamina. IJzer: b: Wood: quick thrust, 16 stamina. Iron: wide breaking slash, 28. Crystal: long narrow thrust, 24. Every technique opens a shield. Precise shot: 20 stamina, 1 arrow, longer preparation and greater range.
Houses stand on the former reed beds. Long mooring posts rise far above the low water. Trade is growing.
en.Huizen verwarmd, bewoners terug en Bergp: Houses heated, residents returned and Mountain Pass opened.
en.Hé daar, oppassen waar je loopt! De turf: Hey there, watch your step! The peat fields catch you off guard; before you know it you sink to your ankles.
en.Hé {arena_title}! Wat kan ik voor je doe: Hey {arena_title}! What can I do for you?
en.Hé! Jij bent dat reizigertje van Bram, h: Hey! You're Bram's little traveler, right? I'm Greta, the smith.
Hey, a bow! Come on over.
IJsdal lives off the mine and the herbs. The snow gives and the snow takes.
IJsdal is on no old map. We found it when the snow drove us here.
en.Ijskristal diep in de rotsen. Nodig: een: Ice crystal deep in the rocks. Requires: a copper pickaxe.
I will inspect the sluices first.
en.Ik ben Bram, de oudste van het dorp en d: I'm Bram, the village elder and the keeper of the Blue Map.
en.Ik ben Edda. Dat warme huis heeft ons te: I'm Edda. That warm house brought us back. The winter kitchen is open again, even when you arrive late.
en.Ik ben Lotte. Ik maak lantaarns voor het: I'm Lotte. I make lanterns for the village.
en.Ik ben Noor. Ik verzamel alles wat glimt: I'm Noor. I collect everything that glimmers in the dew.
I'm Ravi. Sana told me about the spring. Travellers now dare to stop here instead of rushing through.
en.Ik ben Stien. Ik steek turf, zodat het d: I am Stien. I cut peat, so the village stays warm in winter.
en.Ik ben Tessa. Wachter Hein vindt het goe: I'm Tessa. Guard Hein lets me keep my shooting range here, right next to his post.
en.Ik ben Tomas. Ik woon al lang in dit bos: I'm Tomas. I have lived in this forest for a long time. The dew knows me.
en.Ik ben de Wachter van de Sterrenkaart. A: I am the Guardian of the Star Map. I have kept watch here for more than a thousand years.
en.Ik bind de veenmanden vast voor het volg: I'm tying the peat baskets for the next delivery. The bridge stays clear for you. You can fish and find water mint on the low bank.
en.Ik brouw er mistedrank van — koel en hel: I brew mist tonic from it — cool and clear, just like the forest itself.
en.Ik controleer de lonten voor vanavond. D: I'm checking the wicks for tonight. The Mountain Pass is open; look for the climbing line and take some wood for your workpack.
For years I've dreamed of the Golden Carp. A fish of pure gold. Big eyes, shiny scales, way too smart.
en.Ik geef de jonge planten water. Dauwklau: I'm watering the young plants. Dewclaws grow by the stream, honey mushrooms under the trees. Leave the birds some room too.
en.Ik heb hem één keer gezien, vanaf de ver: I saw him once, from the far dock. He swam by, looked at me and... laughed. I'm serious.
en.Ik heb nog nooit zo'n goede lezer ontmoe: I've never met such a good reader. You know more about Azura than Elder Bram now. Just don't tell him that.
en.Ik heb verse vis voor je! ({visgeld} mun: I've got fresh fish for you! ({visgeld} coins)
en.Ik hoor het water alweer! Je hebt de bro: I can hear the water again! You found the spring. The oasis gets enough, and your branch helps the rest of the valley.
en.Ik hoorde dat er ergens in het bos een k: I heard there's a chest somewhere in the woods, guarded by slimes. Maybe there's something inside...
en.Ik houd de overtochten kort. De veer vaa: I keep the crossings short. The ferry sails to the Blue Coast, Gull Island and Tidal Cove, even at high tide.
en.Ik ken het alleen uit de oude verhalen v: I only know it from my grandpa's old stories. It isn't made of iron, it's made of starlight!
I'll look around a little more.
I'll look around for a while.
I knot my nets here, out of the way. The wide estuary lies beyond the western bridge; the lighthouse stands on the eastern cape.
I'll be back with a fish.
en.Ik lees de drie beelden voor: riet, aanl: I read the three pictures aloud: reeds, landing, flood. A visitor can now understand what happened here for themselves.
en.Ik maak een postbundel vast met hetzelfd: I'm tying a mail bundle with the same weaving as the climbing line. That line stays safe even when the wind picks up again.
I will craft it myself via Professions → Craft.
en.Ik maak kleding die je gewoon óver je ui: I make clothing you simply wear over your equipment. No fussing with changing clothes: it goes right on top.
I make cool drinks from cactus figs. Sweet, and they keep the heat at bay.
I will pick them for you.
en.Ik probeer al de hele dag een vis te van: I've been trying to catch a fish all day. But I only catch boots. Look, I'm only wearing one. The other one is... somewhere.
en.Ik roer de wintersoep. IJsbloemen en win: I'm stirring the winter soup. Ice flowers and winter berries are worth bringing to the cooking spot again.
en.Ik schrijf dit voor wie na mij komt. Ik: I'm writing this for whoever comes after me. I spent my whole life looking for the Depths, but I never found the way.
en.Ik smeed vanaf nu zwaarden voor op het f: From now on, I'm forging swords for the party. Well... for cutting the cake.
en.Ik sorteer de nieuwe ertslagen. Het ijze: I'm sorting the new ore seams. Iron and copper near the light circle are now safe to gather; you still need your pickaxe.
en.Ik sorteer zaden op de droge hoek van de: I'm sorting seeds in the dry corner of the garden. Rain and evening change my work, but the herbs stay accessible.
en.Ik tel af: 3, 2, 1... Bij \"Af!\" begint: I'll count down: 3, 2, 1... The clock starts at "Go!"
en.Ik vul mijn kruiken en verdeel de bagage: I'm filling my jars and dividing the luggage. This stop exists because of the spring; you can keep visiting the Sun Canyon.
en.Ik was hier bewaker. Mijn medaillon ligt: I was a guard here. My medallion is in the Echo Cave, but I cannot remember why I stayed. The relief in the western hall and the book in the southeast room may tell us.
en.Ik werk hier van ochtend tot avond en ve: I work here from dawn to dusk and keep forgetting to eat. Will you pick 5 cranberries for me? Then I will make my famous cranberry porridge.
I want to think about it.
I want to sell Slime Gel.
en.In de hitte en tegen de avond zoek ik sc: In the heat and towards evening, I find shade. My jars are full; there's no hurry to enter the canyon now.
en.In de mijnhoek groeit ijskristal: koud,: Ice crystal grows in the mine corner: cold, clear and harder than copper.
en.In de spleet wijst een oude kerf naar he: An old notch in the split points east: find the pale saltgrass beyond the middle of the headland, north of the lighthouse path.
en.In diep water. Aan het eind van de verre: In deep water. At the end of the far dock, all the way on the east side of the lake.
en.Ingeschreven voor %s! Loop door de deur: Signed up for %s! Go through the door into the arena.
en.Ingrediënten uit de bereikbare huisvoorr: Ingredients in reachable home stock count too.
en.Is dat een sleutel? Dan weet je wat je m: Is that a key? Then you know what to do: go to the gate of the ruins, in the northeast of the woods!
en.Je bekijkt de voorraad op afstand. Verpl: You are viewing stock remotely. Visit this chest to transfer items or craft from it.
en.Je bent de beste. Hier, neem mijn schat: You're the best. Here, take my treasure. Now I have to put my boot on.
en.Je bent sterk. En slim. Je rolde door mi: You are strong. And clever. You rolled through my shards like they were nothing.
en.Je bent terug! Kijk vanavond naar de ram: You're back! Look at the windows tonight: that warmth is now part of daily life.
en.Je bent uitgeschreven. Je krijgt je munt: Your entry is canceled. You get your coins back.
en.Je beste tijden. Brons: {arena_best_bron: Your best times. Bronze: {arena_best_bronze}. Silver: {arena_best_silver}. Gold: {arena_best_gold}.
en.Je beste zwaard blijft automatisch actie: Your best sword stays active automatically. See Progress for Greta's prices and the path to the Starblade.
en.Je eerste rang! Vanaf nu ben je een Aren: Your first rank! From now on you're an Arena Fighter. Your trophy is on the shelf.
en.Je gebruikt Lena's proefblaadjes en vijz: You use Lena's sample leaves and mortar. Practice costs no ingredients and gives no potion, pattern or XP.
en.Je haar en je ogen kun je daar trouwens: You can change your hair and your eyes there too, by the way. Forty-five haircuts! I cut them all myself.
You already have all your hearts.
You already have enough of this furniture.
en.Je hebt al het maximum van 8 hartjes: You already have the max of 8 hearts
en.Je hebt alle boeken in de bibliotheek ge: You've read every book in the library!
en.Je hebt alle drie de boeken! Breng ze na: You've got all three books! Bring them to Lena at the library.
en.Je hebt alles! Dit wordt mijn mooiste zw: You have everything! This will be my finest sword ever. Shall I start?
en.Je hebt de Gouden Karper! Breng hem naar: You caught the Golden Carp! Bring it to Joris the Fisher at Silver Lake.
en.Je hebt de beste laarzen. Paden en renne: You have the best boots. Paths and sprinting add their own speed bonuses.
en.Je hebt de oude lichtkring hersteld. In: You have restored the old circle of light. Herbs are flowering in the Dew Garden again.
en.Je hebt de steen! Prachtig. Nu moet ik h: You have the stone! Wonderful. Now I must hear the old story. Talk to Tomas.
en.Je hebt een boog nodig. Tobias verkoopt: You need a bow. Tobias sells one.
en.Je hebt een hengel nodig. Misschien heef: You need a fishing rod. Maybe Joris the Fisher has one.
en.Je hebt er een koperen pikhouweel en wat: You need a copper pickaxe and some mining experience for it. Alchemists pay well.
You don't have a Hero Potion.
You have no suitable seeds with you.
en.Je hebt hem gewoon gevangen, zonder dat: You just caught him, without me even asking? I need to sit down.
en.Je hebt hem! Hij werkt nog. Neem hem maa: You found it! It still works. Take it — it will help you in the dark far better than a normal one.
You have the strongest sword in Azura.
You don't have enough coins (you need %d).
You haven't found an altar yet.
en.Je hebt nog geen blauw altaar ontdekt. G: You have not discovered a blue altar yet. Use an altar to unlock fast travel to it.
en.Je hebt nog geen eten of drankjes. Maak: You have no food or drinks yet. Make something in the Craft tab.
en.Je hebt nog geen opdrachten. Praat met d: You don't have any quests yet. Talk to the people in the village!
You need more coins for these seeds.
en.Je hebt ze alle drie! Ik kan het bijna n: You have all three! I can hardly believe it...
en.Je hebt {shards} scherven, {gel} slijmge: You have {shards} shards, {gel} Slime Gel, and {coins} coins. Golems in the ruins and the cave drop shards.
en.Je hebt één drankje gebotteld met de gew: You bottled one potion with the normal recipe costs and Alchemy XP. Your first preparation also teaches Lena's aiming-lens pattern.
en.Je hoeft hier niets te verzamelen. De ve: You do not need to collect anything here. The ferry waits at the western dock; you can always return.
en.Je inschrijving ben je dan kwijt. Je ben: You'll lose your entry fee. But you'll be fully healed right away.
en.Je inschrijving ben je wel kwijt, maar j: You did lose your entry fee, but you're fully healed again. Come back when you're ready!
en.Je inschrijving ben je wel kwijt. Probee: You did lose your entry fee, though. Try again: fall down, get back up, that's how you get stronger!
en.Je keuze verandert de poel of het havenr: Your choice changes the pool or the harbor wheel. Both outcomes complete the story.
en.Je komt aan in Dageraadsdorp. Brood word: You arrive in Dawnhaven. Bread is being delivered, the smith is at work… but the fountain in the square is spluttering. A gardener could use your help.
en.Je koos een halte voor reizigers. We hou: You chose a stop for travellers. We keep the jars and luggage on this side so the water stays accessible.
en.Je koos ruimte voor het wild. Ik vul mij: You chose room for wildlife. I fill my jars but leave the quiet water's edge to the animals.
Gives you one more heart. Forever!
en.Je kunt niet reizen tijdens een arenagev: You can't travel during an arena fight!
en.Je kunt niet reizen tijdens een baasgeve: You can't travel during a boss fight!
You can't travel during a conversation.
en.Je loopt een stuk sneller. Altijd handig: You walk a lot faster. Always handy.
en.Je mag alles lezen. Alleen niet met natt: You may read anything. Just not with wet fingers. And not out loud. And not... oh, I can see you get it.
en.Je mag hier altijd uitrusten, dat is gra: You can always rest here. It's free for a hero. You'll be fully healed, and I'll write down where you left off.
en.Je mist materialen; je tas en bereikbare: You need more materials; your bag and a reachable chest count.
en.Je mist materialen; tas en bereikbare hu: You need more materials. Your bag and nearby home storage both count.
You open the little gate with the key.
en.Je pijl ketst af op het kristal! Schiet: Your arrow bounces off the crystal! Shoot when the golem winds up for a slam.
en.Je staat al ingeschreven. Loop maar naar: You're already signed up. Head to the arena door!
en.Je staat al op de lijst! De grote deur n: You're already on the list! The big door to the arena is open for you.
en.Je staat naar mijn hengel te kijken. Je: You're staring at my fishing rod. You want to fish, huh? I can see it in your eyes. They're shining like a perch.
en.Je staat op de lijst! Loop maar door de: You're on the list! Head through the big door into the arena. Good luck, {arena_title}!
en.Je staat te dichtbij; loop eerst naar he: You are standing too close. Move to the clear yard path first.
You are too close; step onto the clear middle walkway first.
en.Je steekt rustig je hand uit. Blijf bij: You gently offer your hand. Stand beside Muis until she trusts you.
en.Je vindt me weer bij het water. Een echt: You've found me by the water again. You recognise a real stop by the people who return.
en.Je vist bij een visplek: dat zijn de kri: You fish at a fishing spot: those are the little ripples in the water. Stand next to one and press E. Then wait for a bite, and be quick!
en.Je voortgang is bewaard: je kunt verder: Your progress is saved: you can keep playing in the village.
en.Jelle betaalt goed voor vel en vlees. En: Jelle pays well for hide and meat. And with a bow you take them down before they bolt.
en.Jelle de vellenhandelaar vraagt 2 dieren: Jelle the hide trader asks for 2 hides and 2 pieces of raw meat. Hunt the game of Dorstvallei.
en.Jij bent de nieuwe Arenakampioen! Er is: You're the new Arena Champion! Nobody in all of Azura does it better.
en.Jij hebt ze! Alle drie! Laat eens kijken: You found them! All three! Let me see...
en.Jij komt aan in Dageraadsdorp, het dorpj: You arrive in Daybreak Village, the little village below the temple where the map hangs. That's where your adventure begins...

You arrive in Daybreak Village, the little village below the temple where the map hangs. That's where your adventure begins... But watch out: this is New Game+. The slimes have gotten stronger, and you've brought your best gear!
en.Joris brengt vis, Bo brengt brood. Maar: Joris brings fish, Bo brings bread. But we rarely sit together at my big table. Will you help serve our first meal?
en.Joris' bergwerkpak gebruikt hetzelfde vl: Joris' mountain workpack uses the same weaving. Handy when you gather wood or herbs along the way.
en.Jouw gerecht staat op de kaart! Kom geru: Your dish is on the menu! Come and cook, or chat with the guests at the village table. There is always a seat for you.
en.Kan ik je ergens mee helpen?: Can I help you with anything?
en.Kappen en helmen vergroten je uithouding: Hoods and helmets increase your stamina.
en.Keer terug naar Mira om het evenwicht te: Return to Mira to restore the balance.
en.Kies bij de gedenksteen naast Wilfred ho: Choose how his story will be remembered at the memorial beside Wilfred.
en.Kies bij de sluistafel in de Tijholte: g: Choose at the sluice table in Tidal Hollow: leave the pool in peace, or open the working sluice and approach the keeper for a voluntary trial of strength.
en.Kies een geldige toets of controllerknop: Choose a valid key or controller button.
en.Kies een geplaatst meubel om te verplaat: Choose a placed piece to move…
en.Kies een mengsel en bekijk de ingrediënt: Choose a mixture and check the ingredients; special preparations require Lena's alchemy table.
Choose a harvestable plant to fertilize.
en.Kies een toets, muisknop, stickrichting: Choose a key, mouse button, stick direction or trigger.
Choose a piece of furniture first.
en.Kies je bestaande erf of ontsluit eerst: Choose your existing yard or unlock this building space first.
en.Kies je gerecht. Snijden → roeren → opsc: Choose your dish. Chop → stir → serve.
en.Kies je werk en houd %s vast terwijl je: Choose an action and hold %s while walking along a row; restore works once per press.
en.Kies links wat je wilt opbergen, of rech: Choose items to store on the left, or to take on the right. Search and filter both lists together.
en.Kies twee hele zilverkruidbladeren. De g: Choose two intact Silverleaf leaves. Leave the bruised and dry leaves aside.
en.Kijk achter in de tempel, waar de Slijmk: Look at the back of the temple, where the Slime King stood. There's an old seal in the wall. Be very careful!
en.Kijk dat nou... het gloeit! Pas er goed: Look at that... it glows! Take good care of it. It's the best thing I've ever made.
en.Kijk gerust bij de prismabank links van: Take a look at the prism bench on my left. You will need an iron sword for the mine later. Elder Bram by the temple can help you get started.
en.Kijk naar de huizen: de families zijn te: Look at the houses: the families are back. The Mountain Pass behind the eastern house is open.
en.Kijk naar wat er bijkomt: eerst riet zon: Look at what is added: first reeds without houses, then the landing, and only then the rising water above those same posts.
en.Kijk! De kaart gloeit weer. Maar luister: Look! The map is glowing again. But listen... the temple door has burst open.
en.Kijk, in de tempel hangt de kaart van he: You see, our temple holds a map of all of Azura, made of glowing crystal. It keeps the slimes calm and shows where the land is safe.
en.Klaar! Deel één portie aan de dorpstafel: Done! Share a portion at the village table or take your dish with you. Your ingredients have been used.
en.Kleding draag je over je uitrusting; ver: Clothing is worn over your equipment; you pick a dye per piece.
en.Kleine blauwe sterren uit de vochtige, m: Tiny blue stars from the damp misty verges of Dew Woods.
en.Kleine kooltjes langs een stevige stenge: Small sprouts along a sturdy stalk. Frost softens their flavour. Restores 1 heart and 7 stamina.
en.Kleine pootjes, een witte haar. De afdru: Tiny paws and a white hair. The tracks head south beside the pond. Muis seems afraid of hurried footsteps.
en.Kleine, ronde blaadjes die bij lage temp: Small round leaves that keep growing slowly in cold weather. Restores 1 heart and 6 stamina.
en.Klik een koppeling en druk de nieuwe inv: Select a binding and press the new input. Existing bindings will be swapped.
en.Kolkend groen brouwsel van watermunt en: Bubbling green brew of water mint and cranberry. Restores 45 stamina. Use via Professions → Food & drink.
Get too close, and it hops away.
en.Kom terug als je er een hebt. Dan leer i: Come back when you have one. Then I'll teach you how to shoot!
en.Kom terug bij Greta's werkbank om verder: Return to Greta's workbench to continue.
en.Kondigt een uitdijende lichtkring aan. D: Warns of an expanding ring of light. The open sector stays safe and does not turn to follow you. Leave the pool or walk through the gap. No contact damage.
Cook at Mila’s stove inside the inn.
en.Koop bij de tuingids. Groenten geven zaa: Buy at your garden guide. Vegetables return seeds; herbs and fruit stay planted.
Buy the Swift Boots from Tobias.
en.Koop snelle laarzen bij Tobias. Daarna z: Buy swift boots from Tobias. They become active automatically.
en.Koperen banden verdelen de kracht van ee: Copper wraps spread the force of a sword technique. Craft strike wraps at Greta’s forge; ordinary sword attacks remain free.
en.Kristalkevers stormen na hun lichtspoor: Crystal beetles charge straight ahead after showing their light trail. Prism moths fire along three rays. Dodge sideways or interrupt the moth with your sword.
en.Laat de kronen van appelbomen vrij van e: Keep apple tree canopies clear of each other.
en.Laat de kroonruimte rond de appelboom vr: Keep the apple tree's canopy space clear. Connect water outside its canopy.
Leave the exhibition as it is.
en.Laat de zichtbare ruimte rond de werkple: Keep the visible space around the production station clear.
en.Laat een bereikbare plek naast of voor h: Leave a reachable space beside or in front of the bed.
en.Laat een tegel vrije ruimte tussen de we: Leave one clear tile between production stations.
en.Laat maar zien... Hm. Hm-hm. Die zijn go: Let's have a look... Hm. Hm-hm. These are good. I'll give you a fair price.
en.Laat meer open vloer over; berg eerst ee: Leave more open floor; put a large piece away first.
en.Laat ruimte over: maximaal tachtig padte: Keep room to breathe: up to eighty path tiles and forty fence or gate pieces.
en.Laat ruimte over: maximaal twaalf appelb: Leave room to breathe: up to twelve apple trees in your garden.
en.Laatste wacht: de poort bleef open. De f: Final watch: the gate stayed open. The families followed three singing bowls to the western refuge. Wilfred did not return. He guarded people, not gold.
en.Lage, groene rozetten die in zachte snee: Low green rosettes sheltering in soft snow. Restores 1 heart and 6 stamina.
en.Landbouwgrond · leid water naar een aang: Farmland · lead water to an adjacent tile
en.Landingslijn is al in je tas: Landing line already in your bag
en.Lang geleden viel de dauwsteen uit de st: Long ago the dew stone fell from the stars. It keeps the mist alive. Without it the forest turns dry.
en.Lang geleden was Azura een wilde streek: Long ago, Azura was a wild land with no name. Nobody lived there. Just the wind, the water, and the slimes.
en.Lange, donkere wortels die na vorst mild: Long dark roots that taste mild and sweet after frost. Restores 1 heart and 10 stamina.
en.Langzamer rijpende pompoen voor stoofpot: A slower pumpkin crop for stew. Uses one tile; harvesting returns its seeds.
en.Leen een landingslijn voor beide lijnpal: Borrow a landing line for either line post. Cross the cove without the northern detour. Free, reusable and never consumed. You can also walk along the high path.
Learn Raf's coastal patterns at the harbor.
en.Lees Greta’s werktekeningen in de smeder: Read Greta's working drawings in the smithy.
en.Lees Greta’s werktekeningen naast de pri: Read Greta’s workshop sketches beside the prism bench.
en.Lees Joris’ vlechtpatroon op de westelij: Read Joris’ weaving pattern on the western shore of Silver Lake.
en.Lees Lena’s lensonderzoek aan de alchemi: Read Lena’s lens research at the alchemy table.
en.Lees Lena’s lensonderzoek in de biblioth: Read Lena's lens research in the library.
en.Lees alle oude boeken in de bibliotheek: Read all the old books in the library at Silver Lake.
en.Lees bij het zoutgras waar de loodsen hu: Read at the saltgrass where the pilots made their sheltered resting place.
en.Lees het aangespoelde logboek op Meeuwen: Read the washed-up logbook on Gull Island. Examine the broken timber on the island beach and the sediment at Silver Estuary.
en.Lees het kampbord bij de ingang van de B: Read the camp board at the Mountain Pass entrance and take the climbing rope.
en.Lees maar op de lessenaars. Daar staan d: Just read at the reading stands. That's where the short stories are. The thick books stay on the shelves. They're heavy reading. Really heavy.
en.Leg bij het werkboek op de havenkade uit: Explain where the wreckage came from at the work ledger on the harbor quay.
en.Leg een poortje op het pad, geen geslote: Place a gate on the path to keep it accessible.
en.Lekker bezig. En als je een vors hoort k: Good going. And if you hear a toad croak, just croak back. Always works.
en.Lekker geslapen! Je hebt weer alle hartj: Slept like a log! All your hearts are back.
en.Lena leent haar vijzel. Kosten pas bij b: Lena lends you her mortar. Costs only when bottling: %s. Alchemy level %d (required: %d); station: library.
en.Lena van de bibliotheek mist drie boeken: Lena from the library is missing three books: one on the island in Silver Lake, one in Joris' Cabin, and one with Sanne. ({boeken}/3)
en.Lena's lamp voor de vaste sokkel in de h: Lena's lamp for the fixed plinth in the harbor workshop. Choose warm light, sea light or off. Placing it does not consume it.
en.Lena: dat blad is gekneusd of uitgedroog: Lena: that leaf is bruised or dried out. Set it aside; choose two whole leaves.
Light sandals for sultry summer days. Purely for looks; wear them over your equipment.
en.Lichte soep van honingzwammen met dauwkl: Light soup of honey fungi with dewclaw. Restores 2 hearts and 10 stamina. Use via Professions → Food & drink.
en.Lichte visbouillon: herstelt 1 hartje en: Light fish broth: restores 1 heart and 60 stamina. Use through Professions → Food & drink.
en.Liever wandelen? Achter de kade loopt ee: Prefer to walk? An open high path behind the quay leads to Light Cape. The western river bridge takes you back to the Blue Coast.
en.Linkerstick / D-pad kiezen · A bevesti: Left stick / D-pad to select  ·  A to confirm  ·  Controls: remap buttons
en.Loop je schuin? Dan vliegt je pijl ook s: Walking diagonally? Then your arrow flies diagonally too. Walls stop arrows, but they fly right over water.
Circles around you before a short lunge. Retreats from prism light and burning braziers.
en.Lopen is stil. Wissel gevechten af met l: Walking is quiet. Alternate fights with listening at the bowls; sprinting and rolling attract listeners.
en.Los hout uit dorp en bos. Voor je eerste: Loose wood from the village and woods. For your first axe and pickaxe.
Lotte is looking for her special night lantern. She thinks it was left somewhere in the Forgotten Ruins.
en.Luister bij de klankschaal aan de ingang: Listen at the singing bowl near the Echo Cave entrance.
en.MIJN LAARS! Ik zocht hem al een week! Hi: MY BOOT! I've been looking for it for a week! It smells just like I remember!
Make a watering hole for wildlife.
en.Maak een prismalantaarn bij Greta: via M: Make a prism lantern at Greta’s: craft it with the prism lens and two branches, or pay Greta 40 coins to assemble it.
en.Maak eerst meer delen voor deze hele rij: Make enough parts for the entire row first.
Make fertilizer at the compost heap first.
en.Maak er een bessensnack of een energie-e: Use it to make a berry snack or an energy tonic.
en.Maak het rad vrij met het gereedschap te: Free the wheel using the tools on site. Cancelling costs nothing.
en.Maak het rad vrij · gereedschap ligt hie: Free the wheel · tools provided here
en.Maak onderweg bessensnacks. Gebruik de k: Make berry snacks on the go. Use the inn's kitchen for hot meals.
en.Maak ook ruimte voor het zaad dat je ter: Also make room for the seeds you will get back.
en.Maak ruimte in je tas voor de volledige: Make room in your bag for the full harvest.
en.Maak ruimte in je tas voor de zaden of s: Make room in your bag for seeds or cuttings.
Make room in your bag for the sapling.
Make room in your bag for the seed.
en.Maar drie nachten geleden barstte de kaa: But three nights ago, the map cracked. Its three big crystals popped out and flew off across the land: to the Whispering Woods, the Forgotten Ruins, and the Echo Cave.
But first I have to be quiet. Shhhh.
en.Maar je pijlenkoker zit bijna vol. Mijn: But your quiver is almost full. My reward won't fit in it!
en.Maar op een nacht barstte de kaart. De d: But one night, the map cracked. Its three big crystals flew off across the land, and everywhere the slimes went wild.
en.Maar pas op: als het dorp te veel vis he: But watch out: if the village has too much fish, the price goes down. That's how it goes with fish. And with people, come to think of it.
en.Mag ik het Sterrenzwaard nog één keertje: Can I hold the Starsword just one more time? ... Beautiful. Off you go, hero, the world is waiting!
en.Meenemen → tas · bij je %d · opgeslagen: Take → bag · bag %d · stored %d · transferable now %d
en.Meer dan duizend jaar heb ik gewaakt. Nu: For more than a thousand years I have kept watch. Now, at last, I may rest.
en.Meer ruimte voor fouten? Pim geeft een e: Want more room for mistakes? Pim gives an extra heart when Muis is home. Wilfred gives two shards for your crystal sword when you return his medallion.
en.Meer vijgen helpen niet zolang de bron a: More figs won't help while the spring behind the sand is blocked. Will you investigate the old water route? Nour left a waterskin at the blue shelter beside me.
en.Mees bewaart de verhalen van de bewoners: Mees preserves the residents' stories. Fien includes them in her tales among the archive pictures.
en.Mees heeft ruimte vrijgemaakt voor een t: Mees has made room for an exhibition. The old reliefs await in the Reed Archive beneath the island.
en.Mees toont veilige vluchtroutes. Ada geb: Mees displays safe escape routes. Ada now uses the old landing sites as landmarks for deliveries.
en.Mees vlecht riet tot manden. Het riet kn: Mees weaves reeds into baskets. The reeds crackle in the wind.
en.Meng kruiden met slijmgel of bessen in L: Mix herbs with slime gel or berries in Lena's library.
en.Menu: WASD / pijlen / linkerstick / D-pa:
Menus: WASD / arrows / left stick / D-pad · Enter / A to select · Esc / B to go back
Aim: mouse / right stick · Active device switches automatically.
en.Met een enorme plof zakt de Slijmkoning: With a huge SPLAT, the Slime King collapses.
en.Met een houten zwaard kom je niet ver. G: You won't get far with a Wooden Sword. Greta the Smith can make better gear if you bring her Slime Gel, and Tobias sells potions.
en.Met munt en bes brouw ik een elixer dat: With mint and berry I brew an elixir that gives your legs new life. The library has the stove for it.
en.Met zeeagaat uit de veilige Tijholte en: Sea agate from safe Tidal Hollow and saltwood make anchor bands for a directed guard and counterthrust. The same hand slot calls for a choice; old gloves stay useful.
en.Miauw. (Ze rolt zich op en begint te spi: Meow. (She curls up and starts to purr.)
en.Mijn Visserspet. Ik draag hem al veertig: My Fisher's Cap. I've worn it for forty years. Now it's yours. I have three more at home, but this one brings luck.
en.Mijn beste werk, de nachtlantaarn, is ve: My finest work, the night lantern, has gone missing. I took it to the ruins and left it there.
en.Mijn brood blijft nu droog en de kruiken: My bread stays dry and I can fill my jugs here. Nice work on the fountain!
en.Mijn favoriete lezer! Het achterkamertje: My favorite reader! The back room is always open for you. Read everything you can. The reading stands don't bite.
en.Mijn kat Muis is gisteren het bos in ger: My cat Mouse ran into the woods yesterday. It's so scary in there... Will you look for her?
en.Mijn medaillon! Na al die jaren!: My medallion! After all these years!
en.Mijn oma vertelde over een oude bewaker: My grandma told stories about an old guardian who sleeps deep underground: the Forgotten Guardian.
en.Mijn omzet is verdubbeld sinds de Slijmk: My sales have doubled since the Slime King left! Don't worry, your prices stay the same. *wink*
en.Mijn prismabank mist zijn kern. Zoek in: My prism bench is missing its core. Search the Prism Mine through the Echo Cave. An iron sword opens that side route.
en.Mijn turf gaat weer over de brug. Aan de: My peat is crossing the bridge again. You can now fish by the exposed bank.
en.Mijn winkel draait beter dan ooit! De ee: Business has never been better! The first Hero Potion of the week is yours. Free. Um... almost free.
en.Mila houdt de tafel gedekt. Ik neem voor: Mila is keeping the table set. I’ll bring extra bread for anyone who joins us.
en.Mila wil drankjes brouwen. Breng haar 5: Mila wants to brew potions. Bring her 5 Slime Gel. ({gel}/5)
en.Mira in het Dauwbos zoekt een oude dauws: Mira in the Dew Woods is looking for an old dew stone. It lies somewhere in the forest.
en.Mira weet wat ze doet. Geef haar de stee: Mira knows what she is doing. Give her the stone.
en.Mira wil 3 dauwklauwen voor haar mistedr: Mira wants 3 dewclaws for her mist tonic. They bloom where the mist is softest: by the pond and along the western paths.
en.Mist verdreven, Dauwtuin geopend en verk: Mist dispelled, Dew Garden opened and scout coat received.
Misty and silent. Mira guards the dew.
en.Mmm, dit wordt de beste soep van het dor: Mmm, this will be the best soup in the village. Thank you!
en.Mmm, soep! Al zit het dorp wel vol met v: Mmm, soup! But the village is full of fish right now, so I can only pay half price. Thanks anyway!
en.Moerasvorsten en waterslangen. Ze zijn s: Marsh toads and water snakes. They are quicker than they look.
en.Mooi, je komt nog eens lezen. De beelden: Lovely, you've come to read again. The pictures don't change, but each visit brings another story.
en.Mooi. De vossen zitten in het oosten, de: Good. The foxes are in the east, the hares in the south. They bolt when you get close, so charge with a sprint. Or bring a bow.
en.Muis en ik gaan ook slijmen verslaan. Al: Mouse and I are going to beat slimes too. If they get bigger than Mouse, we'll run away.
en.Muis is gevonden! Vertel het aan Pim in: Mouse has been found! Tell Pim in the village.
en.Muis ligt weer naast me te spinnen. Zodr: Muis is purring beside me again. Her ears prick up whenever someone runs. She feels safe with you.
en.Muis schrikt van het lawaai. Geef haar e: The noise frightens Muis. Give her a moment to settle.
en.Muis snuffelt aan je hand en rent met ee: Mouse sniffs your hand, then runs out of the woods in a big loop, toward the village.
en.Munten, kruiden, geruchten... als het wa: Coins, herbs, rumours... if it has value, I buy or sell it.
en.Na elke ronde heb je drie seconden rust,: After each round you get three seconds of rest, and the crowd throws you a heart. Is a round going really badly? Then the crowd throws you another one.
en.Na elke ronde krijg je even rust en een: After each round you get a short break and a heart from the crowd. But the gates won't open again until you've won every round.
en.Na herstel van Sana’s bron kun je met ij: After restoring Sana’s spring, forge harder wraps from iron and sandstone. A worn pair is replaced immediately when upgraded.
en.Na herstel van het tijrad kun je ook ove: Once the tide wheel is repaired, you can also cross the short central bridge. The pools above the passage belong to the creatures; you do not need to enter them.
en.Na het ordenen van het Rietarchief kun j: After sorting the Reed Archive, make a clear lens with ice crystal and water mint. Less preparation means an earlier shot; stamina cost and arrow damage stay the same.
en.Naar %s: kies de veer op het reisbord (%: To %s: choose the ferry at the route board (%d, %d on the map).
en.Naar %s: neem de doorgang naar %s (%d, %: To %s: take the passage to %s (%d, %d on the map).
en.Neem de tijd. Maar de slijmen wachten ni: Take your time. But the slimes won't wait...
en.Neem deze kristalscherven als dank. Ze z: Take these Crystal Shards as thanks. They come from a map crystal that broke here long ago.
en.Neem hak en zaden · eenmalig gratis: Collect hoe and seeds · free once
en.Neem het klimtouw mee. De verloren weerk: Take the climbing rope. The lost weather chart is at the southeastern shelter. Cross along the top: loose pennants mean calm, yellow pennants warn you, white snow streaks mean wind.
en.Neem je prismalantaarn mee. Onderzoek de: Bring your prism lantern. Investigate the markings by the western roots, the pond and the eastern stone in Dewwood.
en.Neem mijn moeraselixer mee. En kom terug: Take my swamp elixir. And come back when the moor calls you again.
en.Neem mijn zandbalsem mee voor je volgend: Take my sand balm for your next journey.
en.Neem water mee van Sana. Blauwe luifels: Bring water from Sana. Blue shelters offer shade and fresh water.
en.Niet genoeg ruimte voor %s: %d nodig, %d: Not enough room for %s: %d needed, %d free.
en.Niet rennen. Niet duwen. En niet boos wo: No running. No pushing. And no getting mad at the fish.
en.Nieuwe invoer voor %s (%s). Esc of 8 sec: New input for %s (%s). Press Esc or wait 8 seconds to cancel.
A new encounter after your restoration.
en.Nieuwe techniek: herstel Greta’s prismab: New technique: restore Greta’s prism bench to break shields with your third combo strike.
en.Nodig: Rafs oeverlijn, gemaakt in de hav: Requires Raf's river line, made in the harbor workshop. The line is never consumed and works at both posts. Without it, take the high river bridge. The short crossing can be cancelled; no items or stamina are lost.
en.Nodig: landingslijn uit de gratis leenki: Required: landing line from the free loan chest by the western jetty. The line stays in your bag. Without a line, follow the high path to the north.
en.Nog %.0f s actieve speeltijd · resultaat: %.0f s of active play remaining · output: %d
en.Nog geen gouden vis? Diep water, aan het: No golden fish yet? Deep water, at the end of the far dock. He doesn't show himself to just anyone.
en.Nog niet bezocht. Ontdek deze plek tijde: Not visited yet. Discover this place on your journey.
en.Nog niet genoeg. Kom terug als je alles: Not enough yet. Come back when you have it all, and I'll make something beautiful.
en.Nog niets gevonden? Geen haast hoor. Boe: Nothing yet? No rush. Books don't run away. Well, these ones did.
en.Nog niets op de plank. Win een rang en z: Nothing on the shelf yet. Win a rank and put your first trophy here!
en.Nog te verdienen: één hartcontainer van: Still to earn: one heart container from Pim.
en.Nog vergrendeld: herstel de prismabank o: Still locked: restore the prism bench or Mees’s crossing.
en.Nou? Wat kan ik voor je doen?: Well? What can I do for you?
en.Nu de kern rustig is, kan ik hier weer w: Now the core is calm, I can work here again. I'm Ivo. My tools finally stop shaking out of my hands!
en.Nu de oever droog is, kun je de beelden: Now the bank is dry, you can study the pictures in the Reed Archive. Mees is waiting to hear what you discover there.
en.Nu je het zegt... ja! Ik mis drie boeken: Now that you mention it... yes! Three of my books are missing. They were never returned.
en.Nu kan ik eindelijk rusten. Dank je, vri: Now I can finally rest. Thank you, friend.
en.Nu mogen de lampen hun werk doen. Ook in: Now the lamps can do their work. The path to the Mountain Pass stays open after dark too.
en.Oefenen met Lena's proefblaadjes — geen: Practise with Lena's sample leaves — no cost
en.Oefenerf: stap in de gloed bij het vaand: Practice Yard: step into the glow beside the banner.
en.Oefening gestopt. Je kunt meteen opnieuw: Practice stopped. You can start again immediately.
en.Oefenpop · tik voor wachtproef: Practice dummy · tap for guard practice
en.Of eigenlijk van het hele dorp. Maar dat: Well, the finest in the village. But to be fair, mine's the only shop here.
en.Oh, sorry. Ik ben Sanne. Ik ben acht. En: Oh, sorry. I'm Sanne. I'm eight. And three quarters.
en.Onder de Kristaltempel ligt een plek die: Under the Crystal Temple lies a place that isn't on any map. The elders called it the Depths.
en.Onder de mist zitten tekens. Een prismal: Markings lie beneath the mist. A prism lantern from Greta’s restored workshop can reveal them.
An old watcher sleeps beneath the temple. He guards the original of the map. Be careful if you wake him.
An old prism symbol lies beneath the reeds. The grate is clear; the sluice wheel is a little further south.
en.Onderzoek de drie reliëfs in het Rietarc: Examine the three reliefs in the Reed Archive: reed beds, landing and flood. Then go to the reading table in the south.
en.Onderzoek de lier ten westen van het moe: Inspect the winch west of the marsh island. Open the west sluice and close the east one; then restore the crossing with a bridge kit, resin or the guarded winch.
en.Onderzoek het beschadigde reliëf in de w: Examine the damaged relief in the western hall and the guardbook in the southeast room of the Ruins.
en.Onderzoek het tijrad in de zijgrot: Investigate the tide wheel in the side cave
en.Onderzoek het vastgelopen tijrad in de T: Examine the jammed tide wheel in Tidal Hollow, at the end of the western side trail in Silver Estuary.
Shallow peat water among reeds and mud. Use the dry paths and bridges.
en.Ontbreekt: landingslijn · leen bij de st: Missing: landing line · borrow at the jetty
en.Ontdek IJsdal en praat met Fenna, Roos e: Discover IJsdal and talk to Fenna, Roos and Olav.
en.Ontdek de Dorstvallei en praat met Jelle: Discover Dorstvallei and talk to Jelle, Sana and Nour.
en.Ontdek dit voorwerp tijdens je avonturen: Discover this item during your adventures.
en.Ontdek het Kruipmoeras en praat met Stie: Discover the Creeping Swamp and talk to Stien, Mees and Wouda.
en.Onthult de verborgen bosrunen. Mistjager: Reveals hidden forest runes. Mist stalkers retreat inside its light. Works automatically while carried.
en.Ontsluit ijzererts vanaf mijnbouw 2. Ver: Unlocks iron ore at Mining 2. Automatically replaces your stone pickaxe.
en.Ontsteek de drie runen in de volgorde va: Light the three runes in the order of the poem: water, root, star. A mistake resets the sequence, not your clues.
en.Oogst 3 berkenhout per stronk in plaats: Harvests 3 birch wood per stump instead of 2. Never wears out.
en.Oogst alle rijpe gewassen in je tuin: Harvest all ripe crops in your garden
en.Ook in de grot zweven ze rond. Hun tover: They float around in the cave too. Their magic spark glows purple. Smash it with your sword!
en.Oooh, prachtige bessen! Zo rood als de z: Oooh, beautiful berries! Red as the sun behind the willows.
en.Ooooh... een levende! Wees niet bang, ik: Ooooh... someone alive! Don't be scared, I don't bite. I'm Wilfred.
Eastern light path: The Dew Garden.
Eastern road: Forest Edge and Whispering Woods.
en.Op Wilfred. Lena schrijft zijn verhaal o: To Wilfred. Lena is writing down his story, so his name will live on here too.
en.Op de muur staan oude woorden:: Old words are carved into the wall:
en.Op het eilandje in de grote plas ligt no: On the islet in the great pool still lies the sun disk amulet, the last piece of that old world.
en.Opbergen → kist · bij je %d · opgeslagen: Store → chest · bag %d · stored %d · transferable now %d
en.Open %s om te maken; materialen en verei: Open %s to craft; materials and required levels are shown below.
Open %s to see recipes and their materials.
en.Open een kist in de herberg, het bos, de: Open a chest in the inn, the woods, the ruins, and the cave.
Open the ruin gate with the forest key.
en.Open het verborgen poortje in het Fluist: Open the hidden gate in the Whispering Woods with your bow.
en.Open je menu en ga naar het tabblad Uite: Open your menu and go to the Appearance tab. There you put on a piece of clothing and pick a dye colour — I have twenty pots in stock by now.
en.Opent vanzelf van beide kanten en sluit: Opens automatically from either side and closes once you have passed.
en.Opgegeven? Geen schande hoor. Soms is st: Gave up? No shame in that. Sometimes stopping is smarter than fighting on.
en.Oranje lijnen: stap opzij. Blauwe vonken: Orange lines: step aside. Blue sparks: the enemy is recovering. Rocks stop charges and thorns.
en.Orden eerst de drie gebeurtenissen in he: Sort the three events in the Reed Archive first.
en.Oudste Bram, Greta, Tobias, Mila, Pim,: Elder Bram, Greta, Tobias, Mila, Pim,
en.Over de brug naar het oosten ligt Rietwe: Rietwenk Harbour lies across the bridge to the east. Both banks remain peaceful.
en.Over de heuvelrug begint het zand. De zo: Beyond the ridge the sand begins. The sun there is relentless.
en.Over de heuvels ligt het dorp in de morg: Beyond the hills lies the village in the morning sun.
en.Perfect passende handschoenen. Draag ze: Perfectly fitted gloves. Wear them for a 16% shorter cooldown between sword attacks.
en.Pfff. Het hele dorp zit vol met vis. Ik: Phew. The whole village is full of fish. I've got fish in the cupboard, fish in the drawer and fish in my boots.
en.Pijlen voor je boog. Er passen er 40 in: Arrows for your bow. Your quiver holds 40 of them. Skeletons sometimes drop a few.
en.Pim houdt een plekje bij het vuur vrij v: Pim is keeping a spot by the fire for Muis. It’s good to have her home.
en.Pim mist zijn kat Muis. Zoek haar in het: Pim misses his cat Mouse. Look for her in the Whispering Woods.
en.Pim · bij zijn kat in het oosten van het: Pim · beside his cat in the east of the village
en.Pim · oosten van het dorp: vind zijn kat: Pim · east of the village: find his cat Muis in the Whispering Woods, then return to him.
en.Plaats of berg het gratis op via de inri: Place or store it for free at the workshop furnishing table. It has a fixed spot by the wall and needs no upkeep.
en.Plakkerig spul van slijmen. Handig voor: Sticky goo from slimes. Handy for smithing and potions.
en.Plant een blijvend kruid. Bloeiende munt: Plant a perennial herb. Flowering mint feeds bees; picked leaves are used in tea.
en.Plant een blijvend kruid. De bloei voedt: Plant a perennial herb. Its flowers feed bees; its leaves are used in rosemary balm.
en.Plant in je tuin. Drie bloeiende planten: Plant in your garden. Three flowering plants within five tiles keep the beehive working.
en.Plant nieuwe gewassen buiten de zichtbar: Plant new crops clear of the visible space around your production stations.
en.Plant op bewerkte grond met drie bij dri: Plant on tilled soil with three by three tiles of clear canopy space. Connected water within two tiles feeds its roots.
en.Plant op bewerkte, bewaterde grond. Een: Plant in tilled, irrigated soil. A grapevine stays after harvesting. Make more seeds from wild grapes through Professions.
en.Plek past. Ontwerp eerst; pas toe als je: This spot fits. Plan first and apply when you are happy.
en.Plek past. Pijltjes of stick verplaatsen: It fits. Move the marker with arrows or stick; confirm to change this design.
en.Pluk dauwklauwen voor Mira en proef het: Pick dewclaws for Mira and taste the mist tonic.
en.Pompoen, wortels en zilverkruid uit de h: Pumpkin, carrots and silverleaf from the inn kitchen. Restores three hearts and twenty stamina.
en.Praat met Greta om te laten smeden. Held: Talk to Greta to have it forged. No hero or Smithing level is required.
Talk to Elder Bram at the temple.
en.Prachtig vers! Hier, een drankje en wat: Beautifully fresh! Here, a potion and some coins. Come back anytime.
en.Prachtig, ze zijn vers. Kijk — zo brouw: Beautiful, they're fresh. Look — this is how I brew the mist tonic.
en.Prismalantaarn: onthult bosrunen en houd: Prism lantern: reveals forest runes and keeps mist stalkers at bay.
en.Prismamijn: richt de drie spiegels van d: Prism Mine: turn the three mirrors in the northern chamber towards their marked receivers. Each interaction turns a quarter turn.
en.Prismawerkplaats, nieuwe ertsaders en de: Unlocked the prism workshop, new ore veins and the guard-breaking combo.
en.Probeer vrij varen in de proefhaven: Try free sailing in the practice harbour
en.Proef voltooid! Kristallen amulet + 120: Trial complete! Crystal amulet + 120 coins. Put it on in Equipment.
en.Proefstuk klaar. Je tas, ervaring en bel: Sample complete. Your inventory, experience and rewards are unchanged.
en.Raak alle drie de doelwitten op Tessa's: Hit all three targets on Tessa's shooting range within 20 seconds. Talk to Tessa to give it a try.
en.Raak daar het zwevende kristal aan om dr: Touch the floating crystal there to begin three waves. You can retreat at any time.
en.Raak de doelwitten met je boog. Praat me: Hit the targets with your bow. Talk to Tessa to start.
en.Raap stenen op, maak een pikhouweel en w: Pick up stones, craft a pickaxe and mine copper. Iron requires level 2 and a copper pickaxe.
en.Raap takken op en hak boomstronken met e: Pick up branches and chop stumps with an axe. An iron axe yields extra wood.
en.Raf helpt met lijn en houtwerk. Greta sm: Raf helps with line and woodwork. Greta forges anchor bands; Lena makes fan bands and a lamp. Saltleaf and Joris's perch go to Mila's kitchen. Each of the four coastal sources yields enough for the first plans; no daily circuit needed.
en.Rafs haak en lijn. Verbindt de twee lijn: Raf's hook and line. Connects the two line posts at Silver Estuary. Never consumed; the high river bridge always stays open.
en.Rafs havenwerkplaats · terug naar Rietwe: Raf's Harbor Workshop · back to Reedhaven
en.Rechterstick: lijst doorlopen · links/re: Right stick: scroll list · left/right: bag or chest · A: move one · B: back
en.Reis snel naar een ontdekt blauw altaar: Fast travel to a blue altar you've found, using the map.
Arrange your yard outside by your house.
en.Richt je woning binnen in je eigen huis: Decorate from inside your own home.
en.Riet, vissers en een brede oever. Er zij: Reeds, fishers and a wide bank. There are no houses or mooring posts yet. This is the beginning of the settlement.
en.Ringen trekken voorwerpen van verder weg: Rings attract items from farther away.
en.Ritselende bladeren verraden zijn sprong: Rustling leaves give away its leap. Step aside during the windup and strike while it rests.
en.Roos de jageres houdt de paden van IJsda: Roos the huntress keeps the paths of IJsdal safe. Defeat 4 ice-blue slimes in the valley.
en.Roze bloemkussens op korte stelen; gewen: Pink cushions on short stems, adapted to the salt wind on the headland.
en.Rozemarijn, zilverkruid en honing van de: Rosemary, silverleaf and honey mixed at the alchemy table. Restores three hearts.
en.Rustig water, grote vissen en een biblio: Calm water, big fish, and a library.
Quiet, green, and a little bit wet.
en.Rustige, aansluitende stenen. Houd kanal: Subtle connecting stones. Keep channels and crops clear.
en.Sana waakt erover. Pluk gerust vijgen, m: Sana watches over it. Pick figs as you like, but leave the water be.
en.Sappig gebraden vlees met zandkruid. Her: Juicy roasted meat with sandwort. Restores 3 hearts. Use through Professions → Food & drink.
en.Sappige, hartvormige winterblaadjes uit: Juicy, heart-shaped winter leaves from a sheltered rocky edge. Restores 1 heart and 7 stamina.
en.Schiet eerst een paar pijlen af en kom d: Shoot a few arrows first, then come back.
en.Schildbreker geleerd: de derde comboslag: Guard breaker learned: your third combo strike breaks a frontal shield (18 stamina).
Slide the loose jaw to the white seam. Use left/right or the arrow buttons.
en.Selectie bevestigen: 1 verplaatsen · Tab: Confirm selection: move 1 · Tab or direction keys: navigate · back: close
en.Sinds de Blauwe Kaart weer heel is, hoor: Ever since the Blue Map was made whole again, I've heard a soft rumbling under the temple.
en.Sinds de fontein weer stroomt, vullen we: Since the fountain started flowing again, we can fill our jugs right in the square.
Since then, the slimes have gone wild. And under the temple... I can hear something big moving.
en.Sla dus eerst op bij het altaar en neem: So save at the altar first, and bring plenty of potions!
Spend a night at the inn.
en.Slaapt op trillingen. Hij springt naar d: Dozes amid vibrations. It leaps at the source of a loud noise, not wherever you move afterwards. You can also pass quietly.
en.Slijmen geven slijmgel; golembewakers in: Slimes drop slime gel; golem guards in the ruins and cave drop shards.
Slimes in Whispering Woods and the Ruins.
en.Slijmen zijn niet kwaad. Ze zijn gewoon: Slimes aren't evil. They just really love the light of the Blue Map. When the light flickers, they go wild.
en.Slijmgel is overigens prima voor drankje: By the way, Slime Gel is great for potions and swords. Thank the slime for that. Just in your head is fine.
en.Slijmgel! Vijf stuks! Dan ga ik meteen a: Slime Gel! Five blobs! I'll get brewing right away.
en.Slijmgel? Prima spul! Ik geef 3 munten p: Slime Gel? Great stuff! I'll pay 3 coins each. You have {gel}. Careful though: Greta and Mila need it too.
en.Sluiten — ongebruikte ingrediënten blijv: Close — unused ingredients stay in your bag
en.Smelt erts en maak beter gereedschap bij: Smelt ore and craft better tools with Greta at the smithy.
en.Snel terug? Ontdekte altaren staan op de: Quick return? Discovered altars are on the map. Travel refills nothing; resting at the altar does.
en.Snelle groente voor onderweg. Eén tegel;: A quick vegetable for your travels. Uses one tile; harvesting returns carrots and one packet of seeds.
en.Snelle laarzen zijn actief: +%d%% loopsn: Swift boots are active: +%d%% movement speed.
en.Soepele vezels uit één rietplek bij Zilv: Flexible fibers from one reed patch at Silver Estuary. For a reusable line and fan bands.
en.Sommige boeken zijn zo oud dat ze 'Azura: Some books are so old they still spell 'Azura' with a different letter. I'd rather not let those out of my hands.
en.Speel het spel uit in minder dan 60 minu: Beat the game in under 60 minutes.
en.Speel het verhaal uit en herstel de Blau: Finish the story and restore the Blue Map.
en.Spreek Raf de nettenmaker op de havenkad: Talk to Raf the net maker on the harbor quay; he shares his line pattern.
Stabilizes the mine core without combat. Mix stone and slime gel at the alchemy table.
en.Standaardbediening hersteld voor dit app: Default controls restored for this device.
en.Start vrije proef · leenpijlen, geen XP: Start free practice · borrowed arrows, no XP
en.Steek de noordelijke pas over wanneer de: Cross the northern pass while the pennants hang loose. Secure the rope to the eastern post.
en.Stel de druk af: stevig houdt het proefs: Adjust the pressure: firm holds the sample without crushing it.
en.Stevige leren schoenen. Puur voor de loo: Sturdy leather shoes. Purely for looks; wear them over your equipment.
en.Stevige visstoof: herstelt 3 hartjes en: Hearty fish stew: restores 3 hearts and 20 stamina. Use through Professions → Food & drink.
en.Stevige, gekrulde bladeren die na een na: Sturdy, curled leaves that taste milder after a frosty night. Restores 1 heart and 8 stamina.
en.Stien brengt haar turf alweer over de br: Stien is carrying peat across the bridge again. The low water has also opened the Reed Archive. I will teach you to make a lightweight scout coat.
en.Stien de turfsterke heeft 5 veenbessen n: Stien the peat cutter needs 5 cranberries for her porridge. They grow low near the pools of the Creeping Swamp.
en.Stien steekt hier turf. Let op je voeten: Stien cuts peat here. Mind your step: it is soggy.
en.Stil maar. Ik ben Roos, jageres van IJsd: Quiet now. I am Roos, huntress of IJsdal. I keep the paths clear of slimes.
Quiet, please. The books are sleeping.
en.Stoof geeft meer hartjes; bouillon meer: Stew restores more hearts; broth restores more stamina. The first hamper makes two portions. One for the village table, one for the road.
